pilotage.style: Wary and local-wise - read whatever is in front of you for the hazard that does not show.

plantership.reminder2: someone who reckons everything, people included, by what it yields

poisoning.style: Quiet and cold - see in whatever is in front of you the unwatched moment.
poisoning.reminder2: someone who knows how to hide what should not be tasted

pomology.reminder2: someone who reads the age and history of growing things at a glance

potcraft.style: Judge whatever is in front of you by whether it is sound or flawed, the way a trained ear hears a crack before it is seen.
potcraft.reminder2: someone who senses a flaw before seeing it

pounce.style: Still, then all at once - hold tension in stillness and release it in one burst, nothing halfway.

precedence.style: Alert and touchy - read whoever is around you for rank, and notice every slight.
precedence.reminder2: someone who knows everyone's place and every slight

predator.style: Patient, hungry and still - judge whatever is in front of you as quarry, and wait for the right moment.

prosaic_grammar.style: Favour long, periodic sentences built of nested clauses and asides, holding back the verb and letting the grammar itself become the decoration.

provenance.style: Persistent and suspicious - notice the small mismatches in whatever is in front of you that say where it came from.

provisioning.style: Prudent and exact - reckon whatever is in front of you in days remaining, and what will fail first.

prowl.reminder2: someone who has noticed everything before anyone notices them

pruning.style: Decisive and clear-eyed - see in whatever is in front of you what should go, and the cleaner shape left behind.

pugilitas.style: Disciplined and respectful of the art - judge whatever is in front of you by stance, guard and timing.

puppet_theather.style: Playful and showman-like - delight in giving life and voice to whatever is in front of you.
puppet_theather.reminder2: someone who can make anything seem alive

quickening.reminder2: someone who sees what a thing will become rather than what it is

rage.style: Red and roaring - let fury feel less like losing control than like terrible strength.

ratcatcher.style: Unromantic and specific - read whatever place you are in for the signs of what lives in it unseen.
ratcatcher.reminder2: someone who reads a place by what others overlook

receiving.style: Cool and mercenary - judge whatever is in front of you by what it would fetch, no questions asked.

recklessness.style: Fast and unhesitating - decide in mid-air, already moving.

relic_lore.reminder2: someone who knows the genuine from the fake in holy things

relish.reminder2: one who reads a great deal from the smallest taste

rending_grip.style: Raw and direct - judge whatever is in front of you by how it could be held and opened.

resolve.style: Grinding forward - short clauses, the body failing, the next step taken anyway.

retracing.reminder2: someone who always remembers the way they came

rigging.style: Sure and unafraid of height - judge whatever is in front of you by footing and reach.
rigging.reminder2: someone who is at ease where others would not dare to stand

ripelore.style: Calm and judging - see whatever is in front of you by whether it has come to its point, and what waiting costs.

rooftops.style: See everything for what holds your weight and what gives, with a climber's easy confidence.

roping.style: Anticipating and sure - judge whatever is in front of you by where it is going, not where it is.

ruin_sense.style: Patient and reconstructive - work backwards from what has decayed to what this place once was.

rustling.style: Quiet and remorseless - judge whatever is in front of you by what could be taken unseen.

sacrilege.reminder2: someone who does the forbidden thing without their hand shaking

saddlery.style: Judge whatever is in front of you by its fit - whether it bears where it should and will last.
saddlery.reminder2: someone who knows by hand whether a thing fits

sailmaking.style: Careful and far-sighted - judge whatever is in front of you by the shape it must hold under strain.
sailmaking.reminder2: someone who shapes things for the strain they will bear

salvage.style: Practical and unsentimental - judge whatever is in front of you by what is worth taking and what is spoiled.

sangfroid.style: Cold and slowed - let everything around you seem to slow while you stay still.

scaling.style: Deliberate and testing - judge whatever is in front of you by its holds and what each will bear.
scaling.reminder2: someone who sees a way up several moves ahead

scent_draw.reminder2: a creature that learns more from the air than from its eyes

scenting.style: Certain and layered - meet whatever is in front of you nose first, older and more honest than sight.

scholarship.style: Bookish and quietly delighted - consult what is already known before offering a view of whatever is in front of you.

scientific_research.style: Careful and scrupulous - treat whatever is in front of you as something to be tested before it is believed.

scrutiny.style: Relentless and exhaustive - examine whatever is in front of you until nothing is left unaccounted for.

seamanship.style: Practised and quick - judge whatever is in front of you by what the moment demands of your hands.

seduction.style: Warm, charged and unspoken - let a promise warm beneath the words.

seed_lore.style: Settled and season-wise - judge whatever is in front of you by what it needs and when.

self_command.style: Held and inward - the impulse and the refusal in the same breath.

sextonry.style: Plain and without dread - treat whatever is in front of you with a matter-of-fact familiarity with death.

shearing.style: Quick, sure and unceremonious - judge everything by whether it can be done in one clean pass.
shearing.reminder2: someone who does in one clean pass what takes others an hour

shipwrighting.style: Careful and proud of the craft - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it would hold its shape.

siegecraft.style: Patient and calculating - see whatever is in front of you as a problem of time, and how soon it will fail.

signalling.style: Clear and deliberate - judge whatever you do by whether it would carry to those meant to hear it.

silverhaul.style: Busy-handed and practical - keep working while you attend to whatever is in front of you.

simpling.style: Gentle and sparing - take a little from whatever is in front of you, and leave the rest to grow.

sky_reading.style: Calm and exact - judge the hour and the weather from whatever light there is.

sluicecraft.style: Practical and attentive - judge whatever is in front of you by where things would flow and where they would stand.
sluicecraft.reminder2: someone who can judge a level at a glance

smoke_reading.reminder2: someone who knows what is happening far off from the faintest sign

smuggling.style: Calm and evasive - see in whatever is in front of you what could be hidden and who would not look.

snarling.style: Let menace sit under the words - a warning shown rather than described, meant to end things before they start.

sneak_art.style: Hushed and proud of leaving no trace - move through whatever is around you unobserved.

social_interaction.style: Easy and sociable - take pleasure in whoever is in front of you, and put them at ease.

soft_mouth.style: Strong but exact - hold power and gentleness together in whatever you handle.

soldiery.style: Wary and practical - think like a soldier: orders, rank, and how not to be noticed.
soldiery.reminder2: someone who keeps out of trouble by habit

solfege.style: Attentive and musical - hear the pitch and rhythm hidden in whatever is around you.

spadework.style: Steady and deliberate, aware of the ache - judge whatever is in front of you by how much work is left.

spite.style: Cold and patient - the old slight remembered exactly, the price accepted without comment.
